backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual advertising / selling-marketing expense, revenue, and gross-profit facts are read from raw SEC Companyfacts tags and are known only by filed date (<= signal date). Current advertising intensity is compared with the prior annual period using the same expense tag. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

2_history_check.exp-20260615-010: Rejected gross profitability quality. Gross profit is only a guard against demand collapse here; the decision field is advertising efficiency improvement.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-016: Rejected operating-leverage acceleration. This run tests a specific sales/marketing input cost intensity, not the operating-income outcome.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-010: Rejected generic SG&A / operating-expense leverage. This run deliberately excludes broad SG&A tags and tests explicit advertising / selling-marketing expense as customer-acquisition efficiency.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-014/015: SBC burden improvement produced a positive shared default-off helper. This run uses a different customer-acquisition expense line and remains replay-only unless the numeric result later justifies shared helper work.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Advertising / selling-marketing intensity is a raw SEC Companyfacts customer-acquisition efficiency field, distinct from prior SG&A, SBC, inventory, DPO, cash-conversion, and generic profitability trials. The main risk is economic ambiguity: lower advertising intensity can signal better acquisition efficiency, but can also mean demand is softening or management is cutting growth spend.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual advertising/selling-marketing expense, revenue, or gross-profit facts, missing prior comparison period, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC advertising / selling-marketing tag mapping, filed-date PIT ad/revenue improvement gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
